title: Client-Side Storage and Reverse Tabnabbing Rules

rules.name: Sensitive credential or token stored in client storage
rules.description: Storing sensitive credentials or tokens (token, jwt, auth, secret, password) inside localStorage.setItem or sessionStorage.setItem in inline <script> blocks.
rules.remediation_example: Set-Cookie: session=...; Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict  # use HttpOnly session cookies instead of client storage

rules.name: Reverse tabnabbing via target=_blank without rel=noopener
rules.description: External <a href="https://..." target="_blank"> links in HTML pages missing rel="noopener" or rel="noreferrer" (Reverse Tabnabbing exposure).
rules.remediation_example: <a href="https://external.example.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">  # include rel=noopener
